subject: Trading
title: Round Numbers and Psychology
description: A fast breakdown of Round Numbers and Psychology for builders.

hook.text: Bitcoin hit $20,000 and stalled. $50,000, same thing. $100,000, again. Round numbers are psychological walls.

buildup.text: Traders cluster limit orders at round numbers. $100, $50, $10—these are natural anchor points.

discovery.text: A mass of sell orders at a round number creates resistance. A mass of buy orders creates support.

twist.text: Once a round number breaks, the clustered stops behind it accelerate the move—adding fuel to the fire.

climax.text: Round-number levels are where human psychology directly shapes market price action.

punchline.text: Markets are run by math but moved by psychology.

quiz.question: Why do round numbers act as support or resistance?
options: Traders cluster orders at psychologically significant prices
